metadata.audit_name: HVA-03 Human Feedback Learning Loop System Architecture
metadata.mode: READ-ONLY ARCHITECTURE DESIGN / NO IMPLEMENTATION / RESEARCH PROTOTYPE / FROZEN INTACT / STOP
metadata.predecessors: HVA-01, HVA-02, DCE-05/06/07, L5 Learning Signal Audit, Info Gain Audit, Feedback Reuse Audit, L5.3 Capability Boundary Review

key_decisions: Stability-Novelty Paradox resolved by BOUNDING each signal to applicable scope, not choosing stable OR novel
Case Selection changes from GEOMETRIC_AMBIGUITY to REVIEW_VALUE with 6 Value Dimensions + Safety Constraints
Evidence Pack replaces raw dump with 5-level Progressive Disclosure (L1 contains decision-relevant evidence)
FeedbackRecord links Human Decision to Evidence Snapshot (currently only saves decision)
SignalCandidate uses Evidence Signature (structural fingerprint), NOT keyword matching
Counterexample Search is MANDATORY before any Human Boundary Validation
ValidatedSignal contains NO decision/routing/score fields (Authority Leakage Prevention)
Future Case Replay requires independent documents (prevents data leakage)
executive_summary.phase2_target: L4 (Human-Validated) — ONLY if Phase 1 succeeds AND data available

current_architecture_gap.what_exists: Document → P1-P7 → TLD → IS-01/IS-02 → IS-11 Decision → GT Comparison. Feedback CAPTURED but NOT LINKED to evidence, NOT REUSED.

gaps.evidence: HVA-01: 53% Type A wasted, 88% TABLE bias
gaps.architecture_fix: P3: 6 Value Dimensions + Selection Policy + Safety Constraints

gaps.evidence: HVA-01: B2 slower than A, AMB-032 UNKNOWN in B2
gaps.architecture_fix: P4: 5-level Evidence Pack with L1 decision-relevant fields

gaps.evidence: HVA-02: SIG-02 33% FP discovered only by manual P7 check
gaps.architecture_fix: Mandatory Counterexample Search before Boundary Validation

gaps.evidence: HVA-02: SIG-08 unstable with no mechanism to bound
gaps.architecture_fix: Human Boundary Validation: positive + counterexamples + UNKNOWN
Future Case Replay with independence check
BOUNDING: each signal gets explicit applicable scope
P3 diversity constraint + Counterexample Search detects ceiling

p1_evidence.problem: Machine到底看到了什么？如果关键Evidence不存在，系统怎么阻止下游继续猜？
p1_evidence.responsibility: Machine Evidence的结构化记录与完整性声明
p1_evidence.input: Document pages, P1-P7 Observation (FROZEN), TLD output (FROZEN)
p1_evidence.output: EvidenceRecord with p1_evidence, p2_evidence, tld_evidence, is01, is02, completeness, insufficiency_flags, provenance

risks.mitigation: 不在P1层解决 → Counterexample Search在P7层发现

p1_evidence.failure_route: completeness.has_tld=False AND insufficiency non-empty → mark EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT → P2 propagates → P3 raises Review Value → P5 shows L1 Insufficient → Human can UNKNOWN
p1_evidence.validation: Evidence Accuracy: hash match against frozen baseline → drift → BLOCK

p2_candidate.problem: 哪些Evidence组合值得进一步分析？
p2_candidate.responsibility: 从EvidenceRecord提取值得分析的Evidence组合
p2_candidate.output: Candidate with evidence_ref, content_type, machine_state, evidence_conflict, insufficiency_inherited, candidate_type, structural_features
p2_candidate.failure_route: evidence_conflict=True → TYPE_E (boundary potential) → P3 raises Review Value; insufficiency_inherited non-empty → propagate

p3_case_selection.problem: 当前Selection优化几何模糊度(53%浪费)。如何改为优化Review Value？
p3_case_selection.responsibility: 从Candidate Pool选择值得Human审阅的Case
p3_case_selection.not_black_box: Each dimension has explicit evidence source and computation method. Every SelectedCase records selection_reason for auditability.
p3_case_selection.human_intervention: NONE — Machine decision under Safety Constraints
p3_case_selection.failure_route: Constraints violated → RESELECT with diversity; Pool lacks diversity → flag SELECTION_POOL_BIAS → warning
p3_case_selection.hva01_fix: Type A 53%→≤30%, TABLE 88%→≤50%, PROSE 7%→≥15%, prioritize TYPE_E and diverse content

p4_evidence_pack.problem: Evidence存在但Human看不到有价值信息(AMB-032: B2 UNKNOWN despite TLD correct)
p4_evidence_pack.responsibility: 对已有Evidence结构化组织和Progressive Disclosure

levels.L0_minimum_context: text_a, text_b, page, doc, content_type — Human immediately knows case type
levels.L1_decision_relevant: is_in_table, different_cell, is_number_pair, has_text_pair, ends_period, starts_capital, machine_decision, insufficiency_flags — decision key info
levels.L2_supporting: same_y_band, h_gap, x_a, x_b, width_a, width_b — geometry and style
levels.L3_counterevidence: evidence_conflict, similar_different_gt, adjudicated, reviewer_disagreement — contradictions and boundaries
levels.L4_raw_provenance: full bbox, full TLD output, full P1-P7, hashes, timestamp — audit trail

key_design_decisions: L1 contains different_cell (fixes AMB-032: B2 previously did not expose TLD different_cell)
NO recommendation/cue/hint in Pack (prevents automation bias — HVA-02: B2 cue WRONG on AMB-462/313)
p4_evidence_pack.human_intervention: Human interacts: default L0+L1, expand L2/L3/L4 on demand

risks.mitigation: Progressive Disclosure: default L1, expand on demand
No recommendation/cue in Pack, only facts
L1 includes different_cell + period/capital + machine_decision + insufficiency

p4_evidence_pack.failure_route: L1 insufficient → show "Evidence Insufficient" → Human can UNKNOWN; L3 conflict → highlight → encourage expansion
p4_evidence_pack.amb032_fix: L1 contains different_cell=YES → Human sees L1 → KEEP_SEPARATE in <5s (was 45.9s in B2)

human_only_does: Signal Validation (成立/不成立/不确定)
Boundary Validation (适用/不适用/需要限定/UNKNOWN)

ui_contracts.signal_validation: [成立] [不成立] [不确定] [需要限定边界] with positive + counterexamples
ui_contracts.boundary_validation: [适用] [不适用] [需要限定] [UNKNOWN] [OUT_OF_SCOPE] with scope condition input

risks.mitigation: L1默认展示, 不需要从12字段重建
UI只提供固定选项, 不提供自由文本Rule
P3减少Type A → 减少无价值审阅

p5_human_review.failure_route: UNKNOWN → record, no Signal Candidate; OUT_OF_SCOPE → mark, no Signal flow

p6_feedback_evidence_linker.problem: 当前只保存decision=KEEP, 不保存Human依赖了什么Evidence
p6_feedback_evidence_linker.responsibility: 建立Human Decision与Evidence Snapshot的结构化关联
p6_feedback_evidence_linker.input: Human Decision + EvidenceRecord + EvidencePack + interaction log
processing: Snapshot evidence state at decision time

output_fields.evidence_snapshot: Frozen copy of evidence values at decision time

field_necessity.evidence_snapshot: YES — must freeze decision-time state (TLD may update)
field_necessity.evidence_viewed: YES — know what Human saw, judge feedback quality
field_necessity.evidence_relations: YES — P7 needs structural relations for Signature
field_necessity.provenance: YES — audit trail, prevent evidence drift
field_necessity.human_rationale: OPTIONAL — record if present, but do not depend on it (96% no rationale in L5)

p6_feedback_evidence_linker.human_intervention: Human does NOT create FeedbackRecord. System auto-generates on decision submission.
p6_feedback_evidence_linker.failure_route: No evidence viewed (snap <1s) → mark engagement_level=SNAP → P7 lowers weight; hash drift → mark FEEDBACK_STALE → not used for Signal

p7_signal_candidate.problem: 如何从FeedbackRecord形成SignalCandidate, 避免关键词匹配和same-page重复？
p7_signal_candidate.responsibility: 从多个FeedbackRecord提取结构相似反馈, 形成SignalCandidate

evidence_signature.definition: Structural fingerprint of evidence combination (NOT text content, NOT keyword)
evidence_signature.key_principle: Signature is structural feature combination, not text matching. "Human said table 3 times" → NOT a Signature. "{is_in_table:True, different_cell:True} × 3" → IS a Signature.

p7_signal_candidate.structural_similarity: Two cases structurally similar if Evidence Signatures match on ALL decision-relevant fields

independence_check.method: Group by (document_id, page_number). Each doc-page combo = 1 independent observation.
independence_check.hva02_fix: SIG-01 had 5 cases on resnet page 6 → independent_count=1, ratio=0.2 → LOW_INDEPENDENCE

p7_signal_candidate.conflicting_cases: has_conflict=True → status=CONFLICT → MUST enter Boundary Review (not auto-resolved)
p7_signal_candidate.unknown_handling: All UNKNOWN decisions → do NOT form Signal Candidate → recorded as ABSTENTION_BOUNDARY observation
p7_signal_candidate.output: SignalCandidate with evidence_signature, source_cases, human_decisions, decision_consistency, has_conflict, independence, recurrence, engagement_stats, status
p7_signal_candidate.failure_route: independence_ratio<0.3 → LOW_INDEPENDENCE; has_conflict → CONFLICT → Boundary Review; all UNKNOWN → no Signal, ABSTENTION_BOUNDARY

counterexample_search.problem: 任何SignalCandidate都不能直接升级。必须主动寻找反例。
counterexample_search.responsibility: 对每个SignalCandidate搜索相似Evidence Signature但不同Decision的Case
counterexample_search.input: SignalCandidate + all FeedbackRecords + all EvidenceRecords + P7 corpus
counterexample_search.processing: Extract Evidence Signature for all records → find structurally similar → check if decision differs → flag counterexamples + unknown_matches + ceiling_effect
counterexample_search.output: CounterexampleSearchResult with counterexamples_found, counterexamples, unknown_matches, ceiling_effect, cross_document_counterexamples, search_completeness
counterexample_search.if_counterexamples_found: Signal status=HAS_COUNTEREXAMPLES → MUST enter Human Boundary Validation. NOT auto-rejected, NOT auto-modified.
counterexample_search.if_no_counterexamples: ceiling_effect=True → WARNING "cannot determine boundary" → still enters Boundary Validation → Human likely UNKNOWN

risks.mitigation: FORBIDDEN: Machine不能修改Signal → must Boundary Review

counterexample_search.failure_route: PARTIAL search → SEARCH_INCOMPLETE; 0 counterexamples+0 unknowns → CEILING_EFFECT → no auto-validate

human_boundary_validation.problem: Human不应重新审几十个Case。应看Positive+Counterexamples+UNKNOWN, 只回答Signal适用到哪里。
human_boundary_validation.input: SignalCandidate + positive cases + counterexamples + UNKNOWN matches + independence report + engagement report

human_options.applicable: Signal适用于所有匹配Signature的Case. Requires 0 counterexamples AND 0 UNKNOWN. Disabled if counterexamples exist.
human_options.not_applicable: Signal不成立, 拒绝. For counterexamples proving pattern not universal.
human_options.needs_scoping: Signal在限定条件下适用. Human provides STRUCTURAL scope (not semantic). e.g. "is_in_table=True AND different_cell=True".
human_options.unknown: Human无法判断. For reviewer disagreement, insufficient evidence, genuine ambiguity.
human_options.out_of_scope: 超出审阅范围. Needs domain knowledge or more data.

must_unknown_conditions: Counterexamples have same Signature but different decision
Insufficient evidence to distinguish positive from counterexamples
human_boundary_validation.signal_scoped_when: Human selects NEEDS_SCOPING with structural scope conditions
human_boundary_validation.output: BoundaryValidationResult with judgment, scope_conditions (structural only), evidence_reviewed, rationale (optional)

risks.mitigation: UI only 5 options, no free-text Rule
Only positive + counterexamples + UNKNOWN, not all cases

human_boundary_validation.failure_route: UNKNOWN → CANDIDATE (unstable); OUT_OF_SCOPE → DEFERRED; multiple Human disagreement → CONFLICT → adjudication

validated_signal.problem: 只有经过Human Boundary Validation才能成为ValidatedSignal。如何防止偷变成Rule？
validated_signal.responsibility: 存储经验证的Signal, 包含明确适用边界和反例

fields.evidence_preconditions: Structural conditions MUST be true for signal to apply

validated_signal.key_principle: ValidatedSignal is KNOWLEDGE RECORD, NOT DECISION FUNCTION. Records "what was validated", not "what to do". Future Replay uses it to CHECK, not to DECIDE.
validated_signal.failure_route: FORBIDDEN field present → REJECT (schema validation fails); validation_status != VALIDATED → not usable for Replay

future_case_replay.problem: ValidatedSignal不能直接宣布Learning成功。必须在新Case上验证。

new_case_acquisition.source: New documents not in IS-11 or P7
new_case_acquisition.independence: New document → independent; Same doc different page → PARTIAL; Same page → REJECT

future_case_replay.processing: Check preconditions → check scope → check exclusion → match Evidence Signature → return SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN/OUT_OF_SCOPE
future_case_replay.output: ReplayResult with result, predicted_decision, human_verified, human_decision, match, document_independence

risks.mitigation: TLD hash check; TLD failure → UNKNOWN not signal failure

future_case_replay.failure_route: UNSUPPORTED → SIGNAL_FAILURE → REVIEW; FP>10% → COMPROMISED → revalidation; 0 new cases → UNVERIFIED_ON_FUTURE → no Learning claim

risk_mechanism_matrix.prevention: Fewer cases + better Pack + simple UI

E_boundary_quality.metric: search complete, judgment not UNKNOWN, structural scope, 0 conflicts

authority_boundary.authority_leakage_check: NO AUTHORITY LEAKAGE. Machine retains structural authority. Human retains semantic authority. ValidatedSignal is knowledge record, NOT runtime policy. All parts checked.

SIG-01.current: R3, CANDIDATE, 9 cases, independence_ratio=0.33, LOW info gain
walkthrough: P6: 9 FeedbackRecords, all is_in_table=True, different_cell=True
P7: Evidence Signature {is_in_table:True, different_cell:True, is_number_pair:True}, 9/9 KEEP_SEPARATE, independence_ratio=0.33 (5 on resnet p6), LOW_ENGAGEMENT (9/9 snap)
Counterexample: 0 counterexamples, ceiling_effect=True
Boundary: Human sees 9 positive + 0 counterexamples + LOW_INDEPENDENCE → likely UNKNOWN
Result: NOT VALIDATED, stays CANDIDATE
SIG-01.prevention: Independence Check prevents 5 same-page cases counted as independent; Counterexample reveals ceiling; Human likely UNKNOWN; no wrong upgrade to R5

SIG-02.current: R4, CANDIDATE with counterexamples, 4 IS-11 + 15 P7 (33% FP), adjudicated
walkthrough: P6: 4 FeedbackRecords, text_a_ends_period=True, text_b_starts_capital=True, has_conflict=True
P7: Evidence Signature {period:True, capital:True, is_in_table:False}, has_conflict=True → CONFLICT
Counterexample: 15 P7 matches, 5 MERGE counterexamples found, 33% FP, cross_document=True
Boundary: Human sees 4 positive + 5 counterexamples + has_conflict + 33% FP. Applicable DISABLED. No structural feature separates positive from counterexamples. Human selects UNKNOWN.
Result: NOT VALIDATED, stays CANDIDATE (unstable)
SIG-02.prevention: Counterexample Search PROACTIVELY finds P7 FP before validation; Human sees counterexamples; cannot select Applicable; no structural scope exists; correctly blocked from R5
SIG-02.contrast_current: Current system discovered 33% FP only by MANUAL P7 check. HVA-03 makes it automatic and mandatory.

walkthrough: P6: AMB-032 FeedbackRecord, B2 UNKNOWN, A KEEP_SEPARATE, evidence_snapshot has different_cell=True
P7: Only 1 case → cannot form Signal Candidate (need ≥2)
Routing: NOT Signal Candidate. Routed to EVIDENCE_DISTILLATION_FEEDBACK.
P4: AMB-032 reveals B2 doesnt expose different_cell → L1 redesigned to include different_cell
Result: NOT a Signal. System presentation issue. Correctly stays R1.
SIG-07.prevention: P7 requires ≥2 cases; observation routed to Evidence Pack improvement not Signal; no risk of packaging system bug as knowledge

walkthrough: P6: AMB-375 FeedbackRecord, Reviewer A: KS, Reviewer B: MERGE, has_conflict=True
P7: Same Evidence Signature as SIG-02, has_conflict=True → CONFLICT
Counterexample: Same as SIG-02, 5 P7 MERGE counterexamples
Boundary: Human sees positive + counterexamples + conflict. No structural scope separates them (boundary is semantic: sentence-ending vs mid-sentence period). Human selects UNKNOWN.
Result: NOT VALIDATED. Genuine boundary acknowledged but cannot be structurally scoped.
SIG-08.prevention: has_conflict forces Boundary Review; Counterexample finds 5 FP; no structural scope; Human UNKNOWN; signal not validated; needs Boundary Validation NOT direct Rule
SIG-08.why_boundary_not_rule: Without Boundary: period+capital → KEEP Rule → 33% FP → 5 wrong decisions. With Boundary: counterexamples found → Human UNKNOWN → no wrong decisions.

failure_routes.complete_map: Case → P1 → P2 → P3 → P4 → P5 → P6 → P7 → Counterexample → Boundary → ValidatedSignal → Replay → Reuse/Failure → (loop to P6)

phase1_success_criteria: FeedbackRecord generated for all 45 IS-11 cases
Evidence Signature correctly groups similar cases
Counterexample Search finds SIG-02 5 P7 FP
Evidence Pack L1 for AMB-032 shows different_cell=YES
Independence check detects resnet p6 cluster

architecture_judgment.stability_novelty_resolution: NOT resolved by choosing stable OR novel. Resolved by BOUNDING each signal to applicable scope. Stable signals → ceiling effect → UNKNOWN. Novel signals → counterexamples → UNKNOWN or scoping. Neither wrongly upgraded.
architecture_judgment.hva01_addressed: P3 Selection: Type A 53%→≤30%, TABLE 88%→≤50%, PROSE 7%→≥15%. P4 Pack: L1 contains decision-relevant evidence, no cue. P3+P4: fewer cases, better Pack, simple UI.
architecture_judgment.hva02_addressed: P6-P7 link feedback to evidence. Counterexample prevents wrong upgrade. Human Boundary defines scope. Future Replay tests reuse. But: success depends on DATA, architecture cannot create data.
limitations: Cannot create data (needs more cases, participants, future corpus)
Cannot resolve semantic boundaries (SIG-02/08 may be permanently UNKNOWN)
Cannot prove Learning without future cases (0 available)
Cannot measure HRR without experiment (not authorized)
